notes.title: Version 2.0 Update!
notes.content:
[b]Updates[/b]
[list][*] Keyboard and Mouse Support
[*] Mac Version Now Available
[*] Updated the splash screen to only recommend using a controller
[*] Cursor will appear on the pause menu
[*] Added a slight bounce to the tooltips
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed dropping body parts when using the D-Pad to select organs
[*] Fixed selecting an organ when opening the Swap/Drop menu when using the D-Pad
[*] Fixed picking up two body parts at once
[*] Fixed LT and RT so that they will function properly when mapped to hug, interact, and sneak
[*] Fixed body parts and organs flying through the ceiling
[*] Fixed dropping organs and body parts through the boards in the HR department
[*] Fixed dropping organs and body parts into ramps
[*] Fixed organs and body parts getting stuck on the top of computers
[*] Fixed dropping organs and body parts through fences
[*] Fixed the tooltip for a dropped body part not disappearing when a scientist takes it
[*] Fixed the title screen sometimes not properly blurring the background
[*] The "Not-so-Solid Snake" and "No Suck" achievements no longer have to be achieved in one single run, ie. getting caught on a floor only requires you to restart that floor, not the whole game
[/list]

[b]Notes[/b]
[list][*] If you plan to play Beware of the Blob with a PS4 controller on PC, we recommend that you download and set up the [url=http://ds4windows.com/]DS4 Windows driver[/url] first
[/list]

Thanks for reading and playing!

notes.title: Ver. 1.2 Patch
notes.content:
Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Fixed that Gates could push the Blob through the floor
[*] Fixed that Organs could sometimes be kicked through the ceiling
[*] Fixed that Organs and Body Parts could get stuck on top of furniture
[*] Fixed the Swap/Drop menu persisting into the credits
[*] Fixed the underwater Square Plate in the HR Department so that it cannot be activated by objects on the water's surface
[*] Fixed that saving and continuing could cause the recipes shown on the Swap menu to be inaccurate
[*] Fixed the temporary freeze that occurs when eating the first Researcher after the other humans on the Storage Department
[*] Fixed the credits randomly appearing when on the title screen
[*] Fixed the Blob having all Body Parts at once sometimes when entering the Sandbox
[/list]

Thanks for reading and playing!

notes.title: Ver. 1.1 Patch
notes.content:
[b]Updates[/b]
[list][*] Added the version number on the bottom left of the title screen
[*] Added a splash screen that indicates the need for a controller in playing the game
[*] Added a crack on the Wooden Beams
[*] Increased the size of the Wooden Beam headsmash area
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed that one of the Gates in Floor 6 would sometimes not open
[*] Fixed the music not fading back in if you go up a staircase and come back down
[*] Fixed that the Blob's model could break during basic animations
[*] Fixed that disconnecting a controller would bring up the pause menu during the opening cinematic
[/list]

Thanks for reading and playing!
